title: Petition for Pardon

signers.label: Approving Justice
signers.note: Filled automatically at approval -- not part of the intake handoff flow.

notes: Built from Bar Procedures Section 2H. A minimum of 6 months must have elapsed since arrest. A lawyer is required. Fee ranges from $100,000 to $500,000. Unlike expungement, pardons are for capital crimes only and always require a hearing before a Justice.

fields.label: Petitioner
fields.prompt: What is your full legal name?

fields.label: Discordia Email
fields.prompt: What Discord email/account do you have on file?

fields.label: CID
fields.prompt: Use /cid in city. This will add your CID to your clipboard. Paste that in here please.

fields.label: Lawyer
fields.prompt: A lawyer is required for a pardon petition. Who is representing you? Provide their full name and bar number if known.

fields.label: Date of Arrest
fields.prompt: What date were you arrested for the capital charge(s)? (At least 6 months must have passed since this date.)

fields.label: Date of Conviction
fields.prompt: What date were you convicted of the capital charge(s)?

fields.label: Convicted By
fields.prompt: Which court or authority convicted you of these charges? (e.g. San Andreas District Court, Supreme Court)

fields.label: Charge(s) Subject to Pardon
fields.prompt: List the specific capital charge(s) you are seeking a pardon for.

fields.label: Personal Statement
fields.prompt: Write a personal statement explaining why you believe you deserve a pardon. Include what you have done since your conviction to reform and rehabilitate.

fields.label: Character Witnesses & Evidence of Reform
fields.prompt: List your character witnesses and any evidence of reform. A pardon requires character witnesses and employee references. Provide names, roles, and what they can attest to.

fields.label: Weapons License Reinstatement Requested
fields.prompt: If your pardon is approved, are you requesting your weapons license be reinstated? (You will still need to see a Law Enforcement Officer in person to receive the physical license.)

fields.label: Hearing Held
fields.note: Pardons always require a hearing, but this field records whether the hearing took place as scheduled.

fields.label: Fee Assessed
fields.note: Set by the Justice on approval -- ranges from $100,000 to $500,000 depending on the number and severity of charges.

fields.label: Approving Justice
fields.note: Rendered in cursive. Filled in by the bot when a Justice approves the pardon -- never asked of the applicant.
